recommendations.recommendation: Surrender your ego completely to the guidance of the Master and follow his direction.
recommendations.rationale: The ego is the main barrier to realization, and surrender removes it.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Love God and all creation, since love is the path toward union with the divine.
recommendations.rationale: Love dissolves separateness and draws the soul toward the Beloved.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Serve others in ordinary activity, living the universal life while still engaged in the world.
recommendations.rationale: Selfless service expresses love and loosens the grip of the ego.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Understand that the Everything and the Nothing are one reality, which the intellect alone cannot grasp.
recommendations.rationale: Reality transcends the mind, so direct experience surpasses reasoning.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
recommendations.argued_against: Relying on intellect alone to know the divine.
